module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: An ordinary automated signal cycles through green, yellow, red and back to green. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: The handbook requires compliance with traffic signals except when an officer directs traffic or space is being made for emergency vehicles. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Treat a dark intersection signal as an all-way stop when no peace officer, flagger or other traffic control is present. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: At a steady red signal, stop completely before the intersection, stop line or crosswalk and stay stopped while red, subject to the separately stated permitted-turn rules. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A steady yellow warns that the signal is changing; if not yet in the intersection, make a safe stop. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: If already inside an intersection when yellow appears, continue through and clear it safely. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Accelerating to get through before the signal changes is unlawful. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Proceed on green only in the indicated direction and when the roadway is clear. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A flashing red requires a full stop and yielding to approaching traffic and pedestrians before proceeding on a clear path. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Stop for flashing red railroad-crossing lights even when no train can be seen. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Proceed alertly and cautiously at a flashing yellow indication. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A flashing yellow warning beacon calls attention to a sign or place requiring added attention or action. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A red arrow requires a complete stop and prohibits a turn in the arrow's direction while it stays red. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A steady yellow arrow warns of a change; if the intersection has not been entered, make a safe stop. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: If already in the intersection on a yellow arrow, continue in its direction and clear the intersection safely. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Speeding up to get past a changing yellow arrow is unlawful. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A flashing yellow arrow permits only its indicated movement, from the proper lane and with caution. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Before moving on a flashing yellow arrow, yield to people in the adjacent crosswalk and other traffic in the intersection. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Use a green arrow only from the appropriate lane, following its direction on a clear roadway. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Before a permitted red-light turn, stop fully, look both ways and yield to pedestrians and other traffic. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A right turn after stopping at a circular red is allowed unless a posted sign prohibits it. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A left turn after stopping at a circular red is allowed only from one one-way street onto another, and may still be prohibited by signs. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Red-arrow turns remain prohibited even where a circular-red turn could be allowed. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Reversible-lane signs and signals can change the direction a lane serves at different times of day. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Do not use a lane displaying a red X. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Leave a lane showing a steady yellow X as soon as it is safe because a red X will follow. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A downward-pointing green arrow permits travel in that lane. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A pedestrian hybrid beacon controls a marked crossing at an otherwise unsignalized location. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: The text describes a hybrid beacon as two red indications beside each other above a yellow indication. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A hybrid pedestrian-beacon cycle begins with flashing yellow before changing to steady yellow. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: The steady-yellow stage of a hybrid beacon carries the meaning of an ordinary yellow signal. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: When both hybrid-beacon red lights are steady, drivers stop and remain stopped while pedestrians have WALK. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: After WALK ends, the hybrid beacon's red lights alternate while pedestrians receive flashing DON'T WALK. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: At alternating red hybrid-beacon lights, stop and confirm that neither your lane nor an adjacent lane contains a pedestrian before proceeding. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: A hybrid beacon goes dark after its pedestrian cycle finishes. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: The handbook exempts these dark midblock pedestrian beacons from the stop rule applying to a dark traffic signal. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Red sign coloring is associated with stop, yield, do-not-enter and wrong-way messages. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Yellow is the warning-sign color for unexpected roadway conditions. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Traffic signals, hybrid beacons and sign colors
module_quizzes.title: Yellow-green warnings identify pedestrian, bicycle, playground, school and school-bus contexts. practice
